name: Point Salad
summary: Card-drafting tableau game where players collect veggie cards and point-scoring cards to build the highest-scoring salad.
rules_text: 108 cards are double-sided: veggie on one side, unique scoring rule on the other. Remove cards by player count: 2p use 36, 3p 54, 4p 72, 5p 90, 6p 108. Shuffle remaining and make 3 piles point-side up. Flip 2 cards per pile into a column below as a veggie market, veggie-side up. On your turn draft either 1 point card from top of any pile OR 2 veggie cards from the market. Add to your face-up tableau. Once per turn as a free action you may flip any of your point cards to its veggie side, never the reverse. Refill empty market slots from their piles, flipping point to veggie. If a pile empties, split the largest pile to replace it. Game ends when all piles and market are empty. Score each point card using your whole veggie tableau; same veggie can count for many cards. Most points wins, later turn order breaks ties.
rating_reason: Card drafting tableau, turn-based strategic, fits engine
